title: Lightning Dimension Notes!
text:
Lightning Dimension Notes!
Post by
Codie (Ztrawbz)
Published:
Fri, Nov 06, 2026
Happy update day! A mysterious hammer has struck the Nursery.
There's only one way to find out: venture into the brand-new Lightning Dimension! ⛈️🪄
Where did it come from?
Catch a Bolt!
svg
... A lightning bolt that is! The Halloween wagon's just left, so you're too late to catch Bolt.
Head through the portal into the Lightning Dimension and grab some Forks in a Bottle. When you spot the storm, place them on the ground and see what happens...
svg
KABOOM! ⚡
You've caught yourself some Lightning in a Bottle!
New Baits!
svg
Take your new haul back to Bore's Cave and exchange your Lightning Bottles for Cyclone Sponge Bait or Storm Chip Cookie Bait.
No more free infinite Baits! You'll need to collect Lightning Bottles for more, but the portal will stay open permanently once it moves to the Sky Castle.

Happy update day! The spotlight is on the Carnival this week! Discover the brand-new Stitches' Spotlight minigame, and adopt your very own Stitches, hopping outside the Carnival under the moonlight... 🎪🌙
Stitches' Spotlight Minigame!
svg
Stitches knows how to put on a show! Run around the circus tent, collect Candy Corn, and try not to get caught in the spotlight!
Run around the edge of the circus tent to collect Candy Corn.
🍬 Collect Candy Corn:
Stitches will use the spotlight to catch anyone who's distracted by collecting Candy Corn. If you're caught, you'll lose the Candy Corn you've collected!
🔦 Avoid the Spotlight:
Use both the upper and lower platforms to your advantage, and discover different abilities to help you escape the spotlight.
🏃 Move Between Platforms:
Use target boards for cover when the spotlight comes your way, but be careful! Stitches will knock them down as part of the show, so don't rely on them for too long.

title: Halloween: Hauntlet Returns Notes!
text:
Halloween: Hauntlet Returns Notes!
Post by
Codie (Ztrawbz)
Published:
Fri, Oct 09, 2026
Happy update day! The Hauntlet returns for its second year, but things have changed since your last visit... 🚪
svg
Hauntlet 2!
Patchy has left the building. There’s new management in Hauntlet 2. Bolt has taken over, and he's made a few changes of his own, too.
As you progress through, you'll find that there has been a renovation, where Bolt has added new doors and areas for you to explore. Keep playing Hauntlet 2 to unlock more of the Journal to find out about these doors!
At certain points, you'll have a choice of which area to enter, with each path offering different risks and rewards. Choose the same area as your friends to stay together, or you'll be split up!
We've also made some changes to make Hauntlet easier to tackle as a team. Items now work for everyone in the room, giving your whole group the information they need to make better decisions together.
🌈
- Dispells ALL ghosts in the room. Be gone!
Rainbow Wand
📱

Phone
🗝️

- Opens its matching door.

- Restores all missing Red Hearts.

💛
- Grants an additional Red Heart, but does not restore empty Hearts.

👻
- Grants a temporary Heart that protects you from damage for one door.

title: Trading Hub Notes
text:
Trading Hub Notes
Post by
Jesse Raen
Published:
Fri, Jul 31, 2026
There's a new Trading Hub in town! Unlock a Trading Phone for free in the Guide by playing for two hours, unlock the Trade License in the Safety Hub, and own your first Neon pet.
Use that Trading Phone to summon a hot air balloon and take off to the new Trading Hub.
Inside The Trading Hub
svg
You'll find new friends Robo Todd and Robo Rob!
Robo Todd will let you post potential trades to the cross-server trading boards.
You can select what you're offering, and what you want in return!
Posting a listing will cost 100 Bucks each time, and you can only have two active at once. So make sure what you're offering is worthwhile.
You can also use Robo Todd to see offers made on your trade, or to modify them if you're not getting the offers you want!
Want to list even more trades? You can add an additional listing for
49 Robux
Robo Rob will let you search the listings for a specific trade. If none of that trade exist, our search engine will show you similar offers instead!
Your Trade Pets
When you've listed a pet for trade, or offered one (or more!) that pet will be locked in your inventory. You won't be able to equip it, modify it, or trade it any other way until you remove the listing or offer. That's to make sure the trades & offers we show are real and can be completed.
Values
svg
The Trading Hub has some guardrails that will block you listing, or offering, trades that are
imbalanced. This isn't intended to create a genuine value system, and it doesn't mean that every trade listed will be of equal value.
This limitation is in place to try to reduce the amount of annoying spam trades or offers you would otherwise get. No offering a sandwich for a Shadow Dragon!
very
The Trading Phone
svg
The Trading Phone can also be used in a normal Adopt Me server to check on your trade listings, see trade offers, and view your trade history!
You won't be able to modify your trade listings, or create new ones, unless you visit the Trading Hub.
This doesn't replace traditional trading, or the other methods our players use to find the right trade. Our hope is that this will reduce the need to constantly server hop while you're online, and convince new players to take their first steps into trading.
We'll be monitoring player data and feedback as you use this new system to help us develop it further! Good luck getting your Dream Pet!
Bee Pass
svg
The Bee Pass is staying in game, unchanged, for another week. Any unused flowers & seeds will be refunded when it leaves.

Happy update day! After 3 weeks of the Journey, we land in Summer Camp! Grab a fishing rod, explore the map, go Skydiving and many MORE - that’s just week one! ⛺✨
Fishing Activity!
svg
KARP HAVE INVADED ADOPTION ISLAND! Help the native population of Rainbow Trout thrive by catching and trading in Karp fish 🐟
Catch Bronze, Silver, and Gold Karp from the island waters and trade them in at the Fishing Shop for prizes!
Claim your starter Bronze Fishing Rod at the Fishing Shop!
Complete Taskboard Tasks to earn Acorns & Karp Bait and start fishing, then spend your Acorns for more!
Check if there are any fish in the waters nearby, then cast your line to start fishing!
Bronze Rod will make catching Bronze Karps easy!
Once you catch enough fish, upgrade your Fishing Rod to Silver, then Gold!
The bigger the difference between your Rod level and the fish, the harder they will be to catch.
Don't worry if you take some time to get good, the fish won't eat your bait unless you catch them!
Trade in your Karp to craft Bait, and buy fishing-themed items!
Prove your prowess at fishing and unlock rod upgrades!
🌈 Very rarely, you’ll see a Rainbow Karp making the rounds in water! Use your best Rod and try to reel it in - it will be very hard to catch with a Bronze Rod!

text:
Potions Update Notes!
Post by
Helen Birchall
Published:
Fri, May 15, 2026
Happy update day! Wizard Tim has moved his cauldron into Adoption Island and is giving you the chance to feel like an Alchemist.
Potions
svg
Coming this week we are giving you the ability to make potions in the centre of Adoption Island that you can feed to your pet to give them different abilities:
🔮 Future Sight Potion - Feed this to a pet to learn what its next needs will be.
🤔 Choosy Potion - Feed this to a pet to give it the Choose need.
☝️ Preferred Potion - Feed this to a pet to give it a random need with a preferred item.
💲 Bonus Bucks Potion - Feed this to a pet to temporarily give it 1.2x Bucks.
🧓 Bonus Aging Potion - Feed this to a pet to temporarily give it 1.2x aging.
🤫 Secret Talent Potion - Feed this to a pet to temporarily teach it all of its tricks.
🙃 Goofy Potion - Feed this to a pet to temporarily have it make a silly face.
🏠 Polymorph Potion - Feed this to a pet to temporarily make it look like a random pet.
🏃 Busy Body Potion - Feed this to a pet to give it a random blue need.
🏠 Home Potion - Drink this potion to teleport to your house's front door.
Ingredients
To gather ingredients for your potions, simply complete Needs for your pets. There are 3 ingredients that each have an identical random drop rate:
Tim's Eaten Sandwich (33%)
Definitely Not a Fork (33%)
Is That a Mustache (33%)
Bug Fixes!
svg
🐛 In case you don’t want a cone, Ice cream cups are now available to be collected from the Ice Cream shop once again!
🐞 When the 'find the nearest water bowl' guide shows in the Salon, it will now use the water bowl in the Salon to grab a drink.
🐛 Some players experienced an issue when hovering over an item in the backpack or on a board that the image would get stuck on their screen. That has now been fixed!
🐞 When you equip a pet, the smoke puff animation will now show!
🐛 The pop-up name for both the Crystal and Basic Egg has now been corrected.
🐞 We've fixed an issue with your profile saves, now when you save a new profile, your other saved profiles don't revert to their default names.

title: New Weather Needs!
text:
New Weather Needs!
Post by
Jesse Raen
Published:
Fri, May 08, 2026
Happy update day! You'll have to wait a while to see them all, but there's new ways to play with your pets in each Adopt Me weather!
New Weather Needs!
svg
☔ In the Rain, your pets will want to splash in a puddle!
🍂 In the Fall, they'll want to jump into a pile of leaves!
🏊 In the Desert, they'll want to dive off a diving board into the cool sea!
⛄ In the Snow, they'll want to build a Snowman!
The weather changes every Wednesday in Adopt Me, so don't miss your chance to see the new Needs every week!
Super Age-Up Potion!
svg
For one week, we'll be selling a Super Age-Up Potion for 225 robux. Use it on your pet to instantly gain 18,300 XP
That's enough to take even a Legendary from Newborn to Full Grown!
The Super Age-Up Potion is tradeable, and may come back on-sale in future updates!
Improvements!
svg
We've also taken the time to make some small changes to the game to make your playtime even smoother!
We added a permanent in-game countdown above the bell to the next change in Adopt Me! It'll show you the next Weather, Update, Admin Abuse, or 2D Tuesday!
With how updating works we won't always hit your server on the dot, but it's a good indication of how far away the next thing is so you don't miss it!
You'll be able to save profiles! Have different moods for trading and roleplaying? You don't need to painstakingly re-work your profile any more! Now, you can save your profile and switch back to it whenever you want!
To fit the new UI, and to make it easier to use your profiles, on really small devices we've removed a level of scaling that made your profile even smaller relative to your screen. Now, opening your profile on those devices will fill the full screen, making it easier to do what you want!
We're going to let you make your Untradeable pets Neon or Mega Neon! This will
make the new pet tradeable, and you will get a warning that the new pet will be untradeable, so proceed with caution!
not
To help with that, locked pets can no longer be made Neon or Mega Neon! You'll now be prompted to unlock your pet first, so you don't accidentally use the one you were saving!
When your birthday rewards auto-collect it was hard to see what you were getting. Now, the little pop-up image and text will be correctly staggered so you can see exactly what you got!
Not only that, you now get an on-screen hint (the pop-up text at the bottom of your screen) to help make sure you don't miss an item!
Made it clearer when you're in a Furniture Storage category by adding a hint teling you to go to the A-Z tab to see your full storage!
We made food from houses act more consistently. When you get it for free, it will always be temporary. When you've spent Bucks on it, it will be permanent!
We've moved the odds display for Birthday Rewards into the pet focus menu, and onto the tooltip of Age-Up Potions. No more running all the way to the Safety Hub to check!
Stickers now have new categories and have been re-organized to make it easier to find the ones you want!
Pet Accessory Chests and any box containing pets now announce their openings in chat, just like the Gifts & Eggs!

title: Pet Wear & Avatar Editor Notes!
text:
Pet Wear & Avatar Editor Notes!
Post by
Helen Birchall
Published:
Fri, Mar 06, 2026
Happy update day! This week, we are bringing something that we know you have been asking for…an improved Avatar editor!
Pet Wear & Avatar Editor Changes!
svg
We heard you complaining about the saddle not fitting the horse (and a lot of other dress up problems) so we're giving you new tools to help adjust your pet wear!
When your pet wear doesn't quite fit, you can click the arrow above the item's icon in dress up mode to activate the new tools!
Scale pet wear up and down to make the size just right!
Adjust its position with the X, Y & Z sliders to make sure it sits in just the right place!
Rotate it to make it fit the angle of your pet!
There are limits to how much you can adjust each piece, just like Roblox's avatar editor! The goal is to let you adjust the small problems that our default pet wear system creates, not go completely wild!
This also allows you to change some of the items on your avatar! You can switch from your pet to your avatar and make your accessories fit just right!
You won’t be able to alter clothing or hair, just like Roblox's Avatar Editor! But you’ll be able to alter your other accessories to make them fit perfectly. To do this, just the same as with pet wear, click the arrow above the item’s icon and use the sliders to adjust away!
Once you have finished changing your accessories, make sure that you click ‘save outfit’ otherwise all your changes will be lost, which we know would be so frustrating!
We've been working on this for a few months (it's been a little difficult!) We're releasing it now because we saw the outcry for it, and we anticipate lots of feedback from you all. Let us know what you love, what you don't, and what changes you'd like to see in a future Quality of Life update. ❤️
Endangered Egg Coloring Competition
svg
Don’t forget that the coloring competition is still going on in Discord. Send us your finished entries there for a chance to win a Sea Turtle, 10 Endangered Eggs and FR Potions!
Bug Fixes!
svg
🐛 You should now only get one notification when your pets are ready to age up AND you have Bucks to collect in the Pet Pen, instead of being notified twice.
🐞 We fixed an error where your pet could appear duplicated - showing up in your pet pen while also equipped - if you hatched the egg in the pet pen and equipped it.
🐛 Galaxy helmet will no longer glitch on the Slimingo when it is placed in the Pet Pen.
🐞 When dressing up your alt pet whilst having 2 pets active, it now focuses on the alt pet instead of the main pet.

title: Halloween: Patchy's Arcade Notes!
text:
Halloween: Patchy's Arcade Notes!
Post by
a
byKotney
Published:
Fri, Oct 03, 2025
HAPPY UPDATE DAY, AND HAPPY HALLOWEEEEEN! Our first update in October begins the four-week Halloween season! Introducing a new way to adopt a FREE Kitty Bat! Explore Patchy’s Arcade and do your best to escape The Hauntlet! 🧸
The Hauntlet!
svg
em
Patchy welcomes you to his arcade! Come on, take a step further. What could go wrong?
Pick between three doors, round after round, to make it as far as you can!
Each type of door has a different chance of risk and rewards attached to it. Make your choices wisely!
Use the items you find in each room to give yourself the best chances of survival!
The further you get, the stronger the monsters will be!
🍬 Get as far as you can to earn Candy Corn and Bucks rewards!
🍎 Earn a Yarn Apple by reaching room 50!
🐕 Take your pet into The Hauntlet to age them as you play!
Items:
🧪 Heart Potion: Heals all missing RED hearts.
📱 Phone: On the phone, Patchy ALWAYS LIES - DO NOT follow the arrow!
🗝️ Key: Unlocks a safer, richer path.
👾 Monster Repellant: Makes you safe from monsters for 1 room.
🌈 Rainbow Wand: Reveals all safe doors in the room.
🗝️ Golden Key - Matches a door.
🧪 Golden Heart Potion: Gain an additional Heart and restore all your missing red Hearts.
Play the Hauntlet and explore the journal to learn about different types of Doors!
Kitty Bat and the Horseman’s pouch!
svg
To adopt the Legendary Kitty Bat, you’ll need to gain its trust!
Kitty Bats show up twice an hour, every hour, for three minutes - 17 minutes after every hour, and 47 minutes after every hour. (eg. 11:17-11:20 and 11:47-11:50)
While Kitty Bats are on the Island, use a Yarn Apple to start taming it!
Each Yarn Apple triggers a timing game. Land on the Kitty Bat icon to add 10% to the total! No throw is wasted, missing the Kitty Bat still adds 5%!
Kitty Bats are shy! You can only use one Yarn Apple per Kitty Bat appearance.
At 100%, the Kitty Bat is yours for free!
Every 10 minutes, reach into the Horseman’s bag to pull out treats!

title: Pet Pen & Pet Releaser Features Notes!
text:
Pet Pen & Pet Releaser Features Notes!
Post by
a
byKotney
Published:
Fri, Sep 12, 2025
Happy update day! This week, we’re changing Adopt Me FOREVER! Use Pet Pens to age 4 of your pets while AFK or offline! Earn points and claim Eggs by releasing your pets into the wild! We rebalanced pet aging to make it easier than ever! 🌍
Pet Pens!
svg
Starting today, all Houses on Adoption Island will come with a Pet Pen! A front yard for your pets to run around in and gain experience while you explore festivals, play minigames, and take your other pets for walks 🐕‍🦺
Passively age up to 4 pets at a time
8 Needs per hour while online (800 XP)
2 Needs per hour while offline (200 XP)
Pets can only age up an entire level while in Pet Pens, you’ll need to visit them to keep growing.
Neon pets can be aged in the Pet Pens
Friendship Levels can’t be earned in the Pet Pens.
Why not watch your pets run around in the Pet Pen? You might learn something new about them!
New Pets and Eggs!
svg

🐼 Giant Panda - Legendary chase - 0.01% / 0.1% drop chances

Pet Releaser!
svg
We made some changes to the Nursery! Look around and find the Release door, where you can make space in your inventory and earn rewards for releasing your pets back into the wild.
Be very sure you want to release your pet, there is no going back!
Adding pets into the Release window will reward the player with Points, which contribute to the Basic and Crystal Eggs.
Once pets are chosen and initially sent to release, a 7 minute timer begins. If you’re really sure, the timer can be skipped for Bucks.
You can Cancel the release at any point during this stage and before you officially claim your reward.
Each pet traded in from the Backpack has an attached amount of Points based on their rarity, age, Neon status, and if they have FR potions attached.
If at least 500 points are earned from releasing pets, the player will automatically be rewarded with a Basic Egg. Any points above the Egg costs get saved for the next release as Saved Points.
Saved Points are leftover points after claiming an Egg, either above 500 or 4,500 points. They contribute to the next time a Pet is released and an Egg is claimed.
To claim a Crystal Egg, enough pets have to be released at the same time to earn 4,500 Points. Saved Points from previous Releases count towards this.
Two new pets can be hatched from the new Eggs, along with nearly all other pets available to adopt in game right now, with the exception of Robux pets.
New pets will be available with new events, so check the board in the Nursery for up-to-date hatch pools!
Along with these new features, we made some changes to the balancing of Pet Aging. Growing your pets and making neons will be easier than ever!

or tag us @ PlayAdoptMe on all platforms!

title: 🥰 PET NEEDS REVAMP RELEASE NOTES! 🥰
text:
🥰 PET NEEDS REVAMP RELEASE NOTES! 🥰
Post by
a
byKotney
Published:
Mon, Nov 04, 2024
Happy Monday! This Friday, we’re introducing a new way to care for and interact with your pets! Tap on your pet to see their Tricks, dress them up in an adorable new interaction window, and complete their new and improved Needs! 🤠
NEW PET NEEDS! 🚽
svg
Potty! - take your pet to the nearest Fire Hydrant or Toilet to take care of their Potty need!
Catch! - use a toy to play with your pet!
Ride! - take your pet on a ride in a vehicle or stroller!
Walk! - explore the world with your pet!
ADVANCED PET NEEDS! 🍕
svg
These pet needs have a chance of appearing once a Player has completed enough Total Needs. Needs completed before this release count towards your total!
Choose! - Your pets may ask what YOU want to do! In that case, you’ll have a choice between 3 pet needs as your next activity.
Note: Players must have completed a total 50 needs for the Choose! need to start appearing.
Specific Item Requests in the Hungry, Thirsty, Play, Walk, and Ride needs! Your pets can ask to play with their favorite toy, beg for a specific treat, or even lead you to a shop for something new! These Needs are worth 3x the XP and Bucks.
Note: Players must have completed a total 100 needs for the Specific Item Requests need to start appearing.
NEEDS SYSTEM IMPROVEMENTS! 🥚
svg
If a player leaves the game and rejoins within the same Day/Night cycle, the pet needs will save and appear again!
Needs transfer from your Eggs to your Pets - once an Egg has been hatched, your new pet will keep the same needs!
NEW PET UI 🥺
svg
Needs are now visible directly above the pet or baby’s head, freeing up UI space!
Interacting with your pet opens up a new close-up window! Dress up your pet, ride or fly them, and see all Needs in a new, interactive window. Their pleading face is twice as effective now!
Note: The old bubble menu is still available to turn on in Settings > Gameplay > Advanced Pet Menu, with the close-up menu showing when tapping Needs.
img
Video of the new zoom-in pet UI feature. The Dog is Hungry, needs the Potty and wants to go on a Ride!
CHANGES TO FRIENDS, FAMILY, AND BABIES!
svg
Friends and family can now see pet needs when near the pet, not just while holding it.
Babies do not get the Choose! or Specific Item Requests.
Babies cannot be zoomed in on in the new interaction window.
Babies can now pick up pets and use strollers.
Pet Need improvements are coming to Adopt Me this Friday, November 8th.
Check out our Update Countdown to find out how long you have to wait!

Published:

Happy update day! Dry winds have swept away any last memories of winter in Adopt Me. Meet the Sphinx and solve their riddle to hatch your first Desert Egg pets two days early! 🥚🌵
em
Ahlan, little you. Good afternoon.
The sun's bright out here, in the dune.
Adjust your eyes, solve my riddle, receive a boon.
[...]
Spend 30 minutes playing Adopt Me to unlock a statue of one of the pets in the upcoming Desert Egg, up to 2 a day.
Progress on the statues resets daily - progress from multiple days won’t add up.
Put each statue on its pedestal after matching hieroglyphs to its features. Each correct match rewards the player with 25 Bucks.
There are 12 statues to unlock in total.
After placing all 12 statues on their corresponding pedestals, the Sphinx will grant the player the Royal Desert Egg -
your first chance to hatch a Desert Egg pet with higher drop chances than usual!
The Royal Desert Egg and pets hatched from it will be tradeable.
The earliest players will be able to do this is Tuesday (12 pet statues at 2 per day is 6 days total,
)
You will be able to hatch Desert Egg pets before the update arrives!
2 days before the official release!
Next week, Desert Egg will replace the Urban Egg in the nursery on January 25th. If you missed a few days of the riddle, Sphinx’s Statue Solution will stick around until February 1st. 🥚🏜️
We also added three new cars with the Mega Car Pack gamepass! The Ultra Cars gamepass is still available in the shop tab.

Happy update day! This week we’re adding Quick Chat to trading, along with other improvements! Adopt your own Pelican & Eel pets, or play with the Pelican as part of the Jazwares Coffee Shop Playset ☕👋🏼
🐍 Eel - 1000 Bucks - Uncommon
🐧 Pelican - 350 Robux - Ultra Rare
Along with two new pets, we’re rolling out a number of Trading Improvements:
Quick Chat, for easier communication while trading. This will be particularly useful for players with Chat turned off, allowing quick communication using canned messages.
Trade chat
Click one of these icons in the trading chat to quickly say what you need:
👋🏽 Hi!
🤔 Please wait, I’m thinking about it.
🤝🏼 Thanks! Let’s do it.
➕ Please add more.
➖ Please remove some.
❌ No thanks.
Added a new Setting to toggle which messages the player will see:
All - See all messages in the trading window. This includes all options below.
System only - only see automatic messages sent by the system, i.e. “Trade partner added Unicorn.”
Partner only - only see messages from your Trading Partner - this includes anything another player says!
Quick Replies - only show Quick Replies sent by your Trading Partner - see above list.
None - don’t show any messages in the trading chat.
“...” indicators showing your Trade Partner currently typing in the chat or searching for an item in their backpack. Don’t worry about taking your time, the other person will now see you searching for their Dream Pet!
Trade partner searching and typing indicators
Watch active trades by clicking on one of the players in the trade and selecting “Spectate”.
Spectators can use emojis to react to the active trade!
Trade Spectate
Icons in the trading window to indicate that your trading partner is a verified friend of yours, an Uplift Games developer, or an Influencer.

title: QoL changes, Jungle theme, New Supermarket Update Notes!
text:
QoL changes, Jungle theme, New Supermarket Update Notes!
Post by
a
byKotney
Published:
Thu, Aug 03, 2023
Happy update day! This week, we’re bringing back the Supermarket! Three new Jungle-themed pets are up for adoption! And a huge number of Quality of Life changes based on our community’s feedback! 🥰
Thank you for sharing your thoughts with us - if you want to see something that isn’t on that list, tag us on social media, @
! 🤠
PlayAdoptMe
strong
General
Increased the daily Bucks cap to 200 (from 150) & implemented an additional 200 rollover budget (for needs spawned in one in-game day, and completed the next day).
Only family members can pick up babies/ride on adults’ shoulders.
Friends have the same permissions as family members (picking up babies/riding on adults’ shoulders, access to vehicles). This can be toggled off in the settings.
Players are no longer able to block the entrance to houses with vehicles or furniture:
Toy furniture is much more difficult to place in front of doors and can no be longer placed on empty plots.
Players and vehicles get teleported out of the way or unequipped when a new house spawns on a plot.
It’s no longer required to have the Salon or Pizza shop roles to use the hairspray on your own pet or make a pizza.
Job roles are removed automatically when leaving one of those buildings.
New job roles: Doctor and Nurse at the Hospital, and Teacher and Principal at the School! These roles can pick up other people’s pets and babies in their buildings.
Unlimited ingredients in Pizza Shop bowls! You can still refill them, but that action won’t be necessary to make pizzas.
Pizza Ingredients have been moved to the Food category in the backpack, and disappear when a player leaves the game.
We’ve removed the Feedback interaction from the Salon and Pizza shop. Thank you for your thoughts!
Raw Pizza dough can be eaten now! Yummy. (Don't try this at home!)
Water Coolers in the Hospital now give out water.
Party Invites from players with disabled chats will now have an automated message.
strong
Housing Quality of Life changes
Added an advanced color picker to furniture pieces & updated the color picker visuals for all color picker windows.
Added multi-furniture coloring. This needs to be turned on in the settings window.
After selecting furniture, the browser will return back to the previously opened category.
Reorganized the Stuff categories to be more intuitive and descriptive.
The search bar will now remember what was previously typed into it.
Added an option to Delete All Furniture.
Added an Undo button. This is not available when building with friends.
Added a clone selected button - this buys the selected furniture and replicates the position, color, etc.
Added the ability to Enable/Disable “Build With Friends” from the Bench Interact menu.
“Build With Friends” is off when first added to a house and automatically turns on when players add a builder.
Fixed a bug that caused random furniture to appear when searching for something specific.
Fixed a bug that caused the wrong furniture to be sold when a player accidentally clicks on it while deleting other pieces.
We’re aware of a bug that causes the text to appear really small in the Stuff category search bar - it’s been reported to Roblox as a bug.
🌴
Wasn’t playing Adopt Me when the Jungle Egg was around? We’re bringing the theme back with 3 new pets!
Jungle theme!
🦚 Bird of Paradise - 1300 Bucks - Rare
🦦 Fossa - 500 Bucks - Uncommon
🐜 Giant Anteater - 100 Robux - Rare
🍎
The Supermarket is back! From now on, you can get all your groceries in one place. They even have fresh donuts!
Supermarket
Shh! You can still access the Farm Shop and Ladybugs through a secret door in the Supermarket.
🛒 Shopping Cart Stroller - 200 Bucks - Common

Friendship Bar & Safari Theme Update Notes!
Post by
a
byKotney
Published:
Thu, Jul 13, 2023
Happy update day! For the first time in FOUR years, Safari pets are coming to Adoption Island! We’re introducing a new feature, the Friendship Bar! New UGC reward pet lands in the Accessory Shop! 🥰
You’re always asking us to bring back old eggs, and while that may never happen, we’re really excited to revisit some of the classic themes! We hope this brings some nostalgia to the players who have been with us for a while and takes the rest of the community on a trip through memory lane!
New theme areas 🏜️
🐽 Warthog - 600 Bucks - Uncommon
🦚 Ostrich - 1300 Bucks - Rare
🦁 Lion Cub - 150 Robux - Ultra-Rare
We’ve also added a new pet to the Accessory shop! You can claim this pet as a reward for purchasing 5 UGC items in our
Roblox avatar store.
🐕 African Wild Dog - Ultra-Rare
Do you want to level up your newly adopted pals, but worry about spending too much time away from your favorite pet? From now on, completing needs with a fully-aged pet will trigger the Friendship Bar to appear above their head.
Friendship Bar 💕
Filling out an entire level will reward the player with an
- this is a
item that can be used on any of your pets to quickly age them up.
Age-up Potion
non-tradeable
The potion can’t be used on Eggs or fully-aged pets.
Your pet’s Friendship Bar will continue to fill up and display friendship levels without a limit, and disappear when that pet is traded.
, so be careful not to lose your progress!
The levels will not come back when the pet is traded back to the owner
When making a neon or mega neon pet, the Friendship Levels of all pets used will combine. (Only the full levels - if your base pets were halfway through a level, this progress will be lost.)
All levels, regardless of pet rarity, take 30 pet needs completed to level up. All Age-up potions hold the same amount of experience.
Code Redemption Kiosk 🕴🏽
As some of our more eagle-eyed players might have noticed, we added a Code Redemption Kiosk to the Trading Hub building. This is where you will be able to redeem special promotion codes for in-game rewards.
When available, the codes will be accessible online, for free - if anyone is offering you codes for payment, do not trust them! 🤠
There are no codes available at the moment.
Bought an Adopt Me toy? Redeem your code at
roblox.com/redeem
🐞 In this release, we fixed a visual bug displaying a gap in the Piranha pet’s jaw.

In Furniture Frenzy, players are divided into two teams, going head-to-head attempting to fill the model rooms with pre-ordered furniture. 🛋️

Run to the furniture pallets and pick up the pieces you need!

Hi, friends! Happy update week! 😌✨
We’re teaming up with one of the world's leading children's hospitals - Great Ormond Street Hospital in London - where every day around 600 children and young people arrive for life-changing treatments. 🏥
Since 1852, Great Ormond Street Hospital (GOSH) has been dedicated to children's healthcare and finding new and better ways to treat childhood illnesses. With support from donations like the one we're making through Great Ormond Street Hospital Children’s Charity (GOSH Charity), GOSH is able to treat over 250,000 children every year from all over the world! 🌎
The flu is going around Adoption Island! Babies and pets are getting sick more often, so remember to take your family to the Hospital when they’re under the weather. Keeping a Golden Apple on hand is a good idea during flu season! 🩺🩹
The
wants to make sure everyone gets the help they need, so report to her after clearing the Sick need 3 times to adopt your own Therapy Dog. Each player can only adopt one labrador, so remember to log in and finish Patty’s quest
visiting NPC Therapy Dog Patty
between the 10th and 17th of November! 🐕‍🦺
We're using this update to donate £48,000, that's over $50,000, to GOSH Charity to support the GOSH Play Team. The GOSH Play Workers and Play Specialists help raise children's spirits, ease the burden on families, and ensure young people can continue to have fun and do the things children should be doing. 🙌

📋 Taskboard Update Notes! 📋
Post by
a
byKotney
Published:
Thu, Jan 27, 2022
Hello friends, happy update day!! We have a very exciting gameplay update coming out today, the Taskboard! Some of you may have already played it in the Test Lab last year, and we’re so excited to finally bring it to the game! Here's everything 🥰
Taskboard’s daily tasks range in difficulty with different rewards - from Bucks to the new RGB boxes, which are filled with toys and pets in the brand new RGB theme! 🏳️‍🌈
strong
Daily Tasks 📆
One task appears in the Taskboard per day, but remember - there are tasks you won’t always be able to do that day! You can keep up to 7 tasks on your board, making progress on them whenever you’re playing Adopt Me. Once you have 7 tasks on your board, new tasks will stop appearing. You can use the reroll 🔂 button next to your task if you want to replace it with a new task. New tasks will appear 24 hours after you claimed your last task - if you don't log in, you won't get a new task!
strong
Hot Tasks 🔥
You unlock harder tasks when completing tasks, and while playing! The more tasks you complete, the more Hot Tasks you’ll unlock to appear in your Taskboard. Hot tasks always reward the player with RGB boxes - you can get multiple boxes from the tasks that take the longest time to complete! It’s good to hold on to the harder tasks, even if you can’t complete them just yet.
strong
RGB Items 🌈
We’re so excited to finally share the RGB items with everyone! These themed items hold a very special place in our gamer hearts, so we hope you love them as much as we do. New toys, pet wear, vehicles, and even legendary pets Chameleon and Squid! 🦑
strong
Seasonal Events 🌴
As you may have noticed, the Taskboard now takes a permanent place on the left side of your screens, which is where we usually put Event reminders/countdowns/icons. From now on, some updates will be included in the Taskboard! This could be themed tasks or just a visual reminder.
This update also adds extra steps to the tutorial at the start of the game! If you’re a new player or want to introduce your friend to Adopt Me, this will be very helpful to get started.

title: Uplift Games x WDC projects update! 🐬
text:
Uplift Games x WDC projects update! 🐬
Post by
a
byKotney
Published:
Tue, Jun 22, 2021
Hello friends! It’s time to give you another update on the projects the Adopt Me Community has been supporting through our charity partnership with WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation! 🐳
We have some beautiful new wallpapers to share with you, along with new coloring pages!! We’ll be choosing our favorites to send some in-game Ocean animals to, so share your finished designs using the hashtags #ColoringAdoptMe and #UpliftWDC on all our social media and tag us! Don’t forget to include your Roblox username in the post, so we know what account to add your new pets to 🐬
strong
US Intern Programme
WDC North America runs a volunteer training and education program in the US for young people passionate about conservation and keen to learn essential skills in identifying whale and dolphin species, data collection and analysis, and giving educational talks to groups on WDC’s work and about whales and dolphins.
img
WDC-Intern-Poster.png
img
WDC-Intern-Poster-Stencil.png
strong
Special dolphin-spotting webcam in Scotland, UK
WDC’s
features dolphins who live in and around the Moray Firth in Scotland,
UK. Part of the funds from the Adopt Me donation will be used to set up a remote camera at Chanonry Point to film the dolphins who regularly visit. This will help WDC field officer, Charlie Philips, keep track of the dolphins and monitor their health and activities everyday. For more than 25 years WDC has been at the forefront of efforts to protect these amazing dolphins and their ocean home. They also work closely with Aberdeen University and their Lighthouse Field Station team who will also use the new camera and who have kindly provided the in-game dolphin sounds!

The Franciscana is a small, vulnerable dolphin who lives only in coastal waters of Argentina, Brazil and Uruguay in South America. WDC is working to save these amazing dolphins from extinction by protecting their home and keeping them safe from threats like pollution and accidental entanglement in fishing nets. WDC’s project will include vital conservation field work to help us learn more about these dolphins and how we can protect them, raise awareness among local communities and work towards creating an area of ocean where the Franciscana dolphins will have special protection around Argentina.

Yesterday was World Oceans Day!! For our first community competition in this collaboration with Whale and Dolphin Conservation (WDC), we are giving one lucky member of the Adopt Me community the chance to design their very own Adopt Me x WDC charity tee! 🐬
This physical tee will be sold for ONE MONTH ONLY by WDC as a piece of official, limited edition Adopt Me merchandise. 100% of the profits will go to WDC to help them continue their vital conservation work and campaigns all over the world.

All designs must be original artwork and must be submitted as a .png or .jpg file.
Entries must be submitted by 11:59 BST on Monday 14th June 2021 to class as a valid entry. Entries received after this cut-off point will not be considered.
All submitted information will only be used for the purposes of the competition to allow us to notify winners and runners up, and will not be used by Uplift Games or WDC for any other purposes. It will, at all times, be handled in accordance with the General Data Protection Act (GDPR).
There is no upper or lower age limit for entering the competition and it is open to potential entrants from all countries. Entrants below the age of consent in their country of residence can only enter with the consent of their parents or guardian who must submit the application on behalf of the minor.
In the interest of fairness, entrants may only submit one design.
The designs do not need to feature the WDC, Uplift Games and/or AdoptMe logos however entrants can choose to include these if they wish, and you are granted a limited, revocable, royalty-free licence to use such logos solely for the purposes of your entry into this competition and to the extent permitted by WDC and Uplift Games.

title: World Oceans Day!
text:
World Oceans Day!
Post by
a
byKotney
Published:
Tue, Jun 08, 2021
Happy World Oceans Day, and update day!! 🐬 To celebrate, Adopt Me partnered with Whale and Dolphin Conservation (WDC) to celebrate this important date, bring awareness, and help them protect the sea life.
To match the in-game Ocean Egg, we will be releasing free World Oceans Day badges, Conch Music Box, a Clam Stroller, and a pet-friendly Seaweed snack. You can claim those from TODAY until the 8th of July from the in-game charity event stand. 🐚
Alongside our donation of $50,000 USD to support three Whale and Dolphin Conservation (WDC) projects, we have selected the fourth project for The Adopt Me Community to support, so you can be even more involved in our conservation efforts. We will be sharing more about the other projects in the next few weeks, so keep an eye out on our social media for that! 🐋
The money raised in the GoFundMe campaign will be used to support WDC, along with their partner, OrcaLab, a small land-based whale research station nestled against the evergreen forest of Hanson Island off the coast of Vancouver Island, Canada. It is through WDC’s adopt an orca program that they are able to help fund OrcaLab’s work. The philosophies of WDC and OrcaLab are the same – that whales and dolphins can be studied without interference to their habitat or lives. OrcaLab’s non-invasive observation techniques allow their team to monitor the lives of the Northern Resident orcas in order to gather vital data which will help them learn about this incredible species and how they can be better protected.

title: 🎒 Better Backpack 🎒
text:
🎒 Better Backpack 🎒
Post by
a
byKotney
Published:
Tue, Apr 20, 2021
Happy update day!! Today we released the mini update Better Backpack with a few new features to the inventory - favorites, item stacking, and the new tooltip! 🎒 Here’s everything you need to know about the new changes and how to use them:
Item stacking 🍎
This change will be most helpful for players with large, messy inventories, and players with mobile and older devices, as it should help with the performance issues.
All items are able to stack, but only if they are the exact same
Pets will stack if they are the exact same in age, neon levels and flying/riding
If pets are at a different stage in the levelling up process (amount of needs completed), they also won’t stack
(Note: There is a visual bug players discovered where Legendary pets won’t stack together, but appear to be on the same aging stage. We’re working on a fix for that, but it’s actually a bug separate to this update)
Stacks containing more than 99 items will show as ‘99+’. Thanks to your feedback, we will most likely add the exact number into the tooltip in a future update.
strong
Favorite items ⭐
Favorite items will never stack, which means that
you can Favorite a pet you want to stand out to make it separate from the stacks!
This also means that items like food and potions have to be separately added to your Favorite category - we might change this in the future depending on feedback, so please let us know what you think!
strong
Tooltip ❔
Clicking on an item now brings up a new description box filled with information about the item!
strong
You can press and hold an icon to equip an item instantly
Right now this includes the rarity of the item, the amount of uses left, and any special properties like age, neon level, and flying/riding.
We already plan to add more to this in the future, eg. the exact amount of items in a stack
We’re planning to bring in more features like these in the future, but it was important for us to start releasing them into the game now - mostly so we could get your feedback as we go! 🥰 We’re so excited to hear what you think, so please let us know if you have any suggestions or questions on social media, all links below!

title: #WorldDayofSocialJustice Resources
text:
#WorldDayofSocialJustice Resources
Post by
Gemma
Published:
Sun, Feb 21, 2021
Saturday the 20th of February is the World Day of Social Justice, an international day highlighting the importance of social justice around the world. Social justice covers issues such as poverty, exclusion, gender equality, unemployment, human rights and social protections. These issues continue to affect the lives of people on a daily basis, which means it’s more important than ever to take a stand against inequality and educate our world.
This year's World Day of Social Justice theme, as decided by the United Nations, focuses on the digital
economy. You can learn more about this
here.
Adopt Me care about social justice, and feel it’s important to educate our community on real-world issues surrounding inequality and discrimination, which is why we wanted to share a few resources for our young and older players and followers to take a look at.
For Kids
svg
BBC Bitesize cover equality and social justice
here.
For Parents
svg
Teaching your children about equality and social justice can feel overwhelming. Here are some websites with ideas on how to introduce these complex ideas to your younger children, as well as writing to explain why it’s important.
Want to really reduce inequality? Help children before they get to school
Teaching Young Children Social Justice
How to Educate Children for Gender Equality
Embrace race resources
Why teaching children about gender could help to reduce sexism
A better understanding of social justice can protect you and your loved ones from discrimination, and equip you with the information needed to make a change in the world, so we encourage you to take a step towards understanding the importance of social justice not only tomorrow, but every day.

#WorldDayofSocialJustice Resources
Post by
Gemma
Published:
Sun, Feb 21, 2021
Saturday the 20th of February is the World Day of Social Justice, an international day highlighting the importance of social justice around the world. Social justice covers issues such as poverty, exclusion, gender equality, unemployment, human rights and social protections. These issues continue to affect the lives of people on a daily basis, which means it’s more important than ever to take a stand against inequality and educate our world.
This year's World Day of Social Justice theme, as decided by the United Nations, focuses on the digital
economy. You can learn more about this
here.
Adopt Me care about social justice, and feel it’s important to educate our community on real-world issues surrounding inequality and discrimination, which is why we wanted to share a few resources for our young and older players and followers to take a look at.
For Kids
svg
BBC Bitesize cover equality and social justice
here.
For Parents
svg
Teaching your children about equality and social justice can feel overwhelming. Here are some websites with ideas on how to introduce these complex ideas to your younger children, as well as writing to explain why it’s important.
Want to really reduce inequality? Help children before they get to school
Teaching Young Children Social Justice
How to Educate Children for Gender Equality
Embrace race resources
Why teaching children about gender could help to reduce sexism
A better understanding of social justice can protect you and your loved ones from discrimination, and equip you with the information needed to make a change in the world, so we encourage you to take a step towards understanding the importance of social justice not only tomorrow, but every day.

strong
Please remember that just because those trading improvements were made, it doesn’t mean that scamming won’t exist in the game anymore.
The best way we can protect you from getting scammed is to make sure you are as informed as possible, so please keep up with our official social media channels where we share information about safety. You can also read this Scamming Prevention article we’ve published on our Support website to make sure you can protect yourself from scammers:
scamhelp.playadopt.me
Let’s get into the new Trade Changes!!
- get yours by completing the three question quiz in the Safety Hub!
New Trade License
The Trade License is a new toy that gives you the ability to trade Legendary and Ultra-rare pets, access your 30 day trading history, and report scammers in-game! You can access your 30 day history by using the toy or going to the Safety Hub.
The Trade License Quiz is made of 3 easy trading questions, to make sure the players know what kinds of trades are legitimate, and which will result in them being scammed.
If you fail, you can retake the quiz as many times as you want!
Players without the Trade License can only trade lower rarity pets, to prevent uninformed players from handing over their best pets!

there directly. **Please remember that we do not give back pets players trade away. The Monkey Fairground is the first ever update that will come back into the game in the future — see it as a travelling fairground, that will come back to Adoption Island after making its way around the world!! 🌎
strong
The Update Notes contain a lot of very specific information, so if you’d like to experience the update in game first, don’t read the rest of this post! 👀
For the more eagle-eyed players who want to know it ALL, here’s everything you need to know about the Monkey Fairground Update:
Monkey Fairground tent is located in the centre of the map, next to the Pet Shop!
There are 6 New Monkey pets available to adopt from the Monkey boxes!
When opening a Monkey Box (Bucks) you are guaranteed to receive a Monkey and two items. Those could be Ingredient items (used to transform Monkeys), or special Fairground themed items, like cars or toys!
When opening a Premium Monkey Box (Robux) you have a chance to receive the special Albino Monkey in place of regular Monkey, and the Staff Ingredient you can use to transform your Monkey into Monkey King. They also have higher chances for the more rare Monkey Ingredients!
You need 3 of the same Monkey Ingredient and a Monkey to transform it into Ninja, Toy, Business, or King Monkeys by talking to the Monkey NPCs inside the Fairground tent.
All items are tradeable — if you’re struggling to get a specific Ingredient, find a friend who has it, and maybe you can help each other!!
In addition to their model clothing, all transformed Monkeys come with their own pet accessory (two for Ninja Monkey), which can be taken off them and used on another pet. Those accessories are: Fez, Head Tie, Kitsune Mask, Ninja Headband, and Monkey King Crown. **Be careful when trading them! Pet Accessories are never traded equipped on the pets. If you’re trading for a Monkey and want the accessories that come with them, make sure the accessories are put in the trading window individually. **
New Fairground themed items — including the Clown Car, Monkey Pogo Stick, and much more!
We hope you visit the Monkey Fairground while it’s in town — it might be a while before it returns! 🙊

title: Adopt Me moves to a flexible update schedule from weekly Friday update — Adopt Me! on Roblox
text:
Adopt Me moves to a flexible update schedule from weekly Friday update — Adopt Me! on Roblox
Post by
a
byKotney
Published:
Thu, Apr 30, 2020
Hey everyone! Let’s just get right to it: **Adopt Me will no longer update on Friday evenings. **This may seem like a shock to some of you, who have been playing the weekly updates for a whopping 56 weeks, but this is a decision we spent a lot of time considering, and we’re confident this will be a good change for our game, our studio, and our community. If you’d like to know why we made this decision, and what it means for the weekly updates, please read on, or watch the video above.
So, why move to a flexible schedule, rather than continue updating every Friday? Excellent question!
There are a number of reasons why we decided to change our update schedule, but the main being
Right now, a lot of the final touches on each update happen on the Friday of the update release, which puts a lot of pressure on the people who bring you those updates. Because of that, to enjoy our newly released update, a lot of you have to stay up late, depending on where you are in the world. It also has an impact on our Influencers, who wait for hours on end to cover the updates as soon as they’re live.
the wellbeing of our Team, the Developers who work on the updates, and our players.
With this new change, you will know exactly when the updates go live.
**This doesn’t mean that you will have to wait a long time between updates. **As our team grows, there will be more people working on new features, and more people working on improving some of the current ones. We will have the time needed to work on more long-term projects, and work on fixing any known issues, making the gameplay better and smoother, and overall creating a more joyful experience in Adopt Me. We also want to make sure that the updates we share with you provide more than just a weekend’s worth of entertainment, so that you don’t have to wait for another Friday to have something fun and exciting to do.
This Friday you won't see a new game icon, or a new update in the game; that's because we're working on some really exciting Adopt Me updates for you to enjoy soon, and some to come in the future. We already announced that there's a new pet coming, and don't worry - we're still working on that! But we're making sure we're putting as much time and love into it as it needs to become your new favourite.
Thank you for reading this, and we hope you understand that this is a good change. We want to be able to take the time needed to make Adopt Me! the best game it can be for our community, and this is the right step in that direction.
Stay safe everyone,
The Adopt Me Team

title: Cute pet-collecting Roblox game Adopt Me! sets new record with 1.6 Million players online, more than CS:GO on Steam
text:
Cute pet-collecting Roblox game Adopt Me! sets new record with 1.6 Million players online, more than CS:GO on Steam
Post by
a
byKotney
Published:
Wed, Apr 15, 2020
On Saturday, April 11, #1 Roblox Game
launched its new ‘Dress Your Pets’ update with a live event, resulting in a peak CCU (Concurrent Players) of 1,615,085 players online at 9AM PST / 5PM BST. This marks a new World Record for players online in a game on the Roblox platform, beating the previous record of 707,814 by nearly 1 Million players.
Adopt Me!
img
Dress Your Pets in Adopt Me!
The ‘Dress your Pets’ update brought in a new, special feature into the game, giving players the ability to dress their pets, collect new pet wear, and make their favorite pets stand out from the crowd in style. The update launched with a live event, where a sunken ship rose out of the water and on to the shore as a live in-game countdown reached zero, transforming into the new Hat Shop. ‘Dress Your Pets’ is the 54th consecutive ‘weekly update’ released by the Adopt Me Team.
img
Source: KreekCraft on Twitter
em
Source:
KreekCraft on Twitter
At the time of the record-breaking player count, Adopt Me! had more players online than every game on Steam, including top game Counter-Strike: Global Offensive, which was setting its own record for CCU of 1,270,315. This also included Dota 2, PUBG and the recently released Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord. Adopt Me now joins the limited collection of games who are lucky enough to have a peak of over 1 Million concurrent players. Twitter users jokingly suggested that the popular gun game should try adding cute pets to collect.
Since June 2019, the Adopt Me game studio has scaled from 4 to 29 team members, expanding to support the huge amount of growth. Roblox isn’t considered a serious platform by many gamers, but with professional game studios like Adopt Me and its games hitting record breaking numbers with a global community of over 42 Million players each month, that perception may be changing.
:
For press enquiries and questions, reach out at
.
Press
press@playadopt.me
:
About Adopt Me
Adopt Me is the #1 World Record holding game on the Roblox platform, enjoyed by a community of over 42 million monthly players across the world with a peak CCU of 1.6 Million players online. In Adopt Me players of all ages take part in a variety of positive, family-friendly online social activities including collecting 70+ cute pets, trading with other players to complete their collections, and decorating their homes in a safe world full of fun and adventure. Adopt Me is developed by the Adopt Me studio, a diverse team of 29 people distributed across the world.

This is an update we’ve worked on for a long time, and we’re so excited to share it with you! It’s the biggest update since we’ve added Pets to the game, which is... pretty big. You're finally able to dress your pets in their own, unique way, making it easier to stand out in a crowd! 🕵️‍♂️
Here’s some information about the Pet Wear Update:
The event starts with a countdown, followed by a live in-game event. This is the first time we’ve ever done anything like this in Adopt Me, so you'll want to be in-game when the countdown ticks down to 0, trust us! ⏰
Most Pet Accessories will be purchased with Bucks, with an occasional special themed Gamepass. You can purchase Hero’s Costume available in game now, for the bravest of pets! ⚔️
Pet Wear in the Pet Shop is on rotation, they change every Tuesday and Saturday. The Ultra-rare accessory will be changed every Saturday. There’s lots of new accessories in the game, so it will take a few weeks before they start repeating! 🗓️
Pets that previously had accessories on (Santa Dog, Elf Shrew and Elf Hedgehog) will give a Santa or Elf hat back. You can put it back on them, or any other one of your pets. Neon variants will give 4 hats back! Those pets will also change into Dalmatian, Shrew, and Hedgehog. 🎅
When trading, Pet Wear is removed! Please remember that when trading with Pets and Pet Wear. You can trade Pet Wear separately, and they take individual slots in the trading window. If someone wants to trade accessories with you, make sure they put them in the trading window — no pet will come with Pet Wear on them! 😎
We’re so excited to see all the ways you style your pets, so make sure you share all your favorite looks with us on our social media, links below!

title: 🌸Spring Festival Update Notes🌸 Adopt Me! on Roblox
text:
🌸Spring Festival Update Notes🌸 Adopt Me! on Roblox
Post by
a
byKotney
Published:
Fri, Mar 27, 2020
Happy update day! It's the Spring Festival update! 🌻 This week we celebrated the game and studio winning
and
, so we're celebrating with a long 2X weekend!
We also know that most of you are stuck indoors right now, and we're so proud to be here for you to hang out with your friends, and spend time with your adorable pets. We hope everyone is staying safe, and remember — we're all in this together (at a reasonable distance!).
5 Bloxy Awards
5 Billion visits on Roblox
Here's exactly what's included in the Spring Festival Update — from the very obvious, to things that could escape even the most hawk-eyed players.  👀
2x Pet aging and Bucks over this weekend, and we're making it a long one — the boost starts when the update launches, and ends at 23:59PM PST on Monday. Three full days of extra bucks, sign me up!!
New Spring Festival stand with 7 new items! Get your Flower Stroller and feel the flower power in the new Flower Wagon!
We've doubled the house furniture limit to 4k items, and you also have some extra space in your backpack!
We've added extra seats for your pets in the Ice Cream Truck and the Witch's Caravan! Your pet no longer have to follow your car as you speed around the Adoption Island.
Some minor bug fixes to the Star Rewards system 🐛
We've added a censor for pet names including the words 'Gold,' 'Diamond,' and 'Neon.' We've also updated the Golden and Diamond egg game icons, to make it a little more obvious what egg it is.
Hope you enjoy the update as much as we enjoyed making it for you!! Now go get your doubled Bucks! 💸💸

title: Slushie Party Notes!
text:
Slushie Party Notes!
Post by
Codie (Ztrawbz)
Published:
Fri, Nov 13, 2026
Happy update day! This week we're releasing a refreshing new update that will eventually join the VIP area. 🥤🧊
Sip, sip, hooray!
svg
Join the Slushie Party! Head over to the Slushie Machine, grab yourself a cup for just 15 Bucks, and start mixing!
There are four different flavours to try, each with its own effect:
🔴
Adds Speed
Red Spiral:
🟢
Adds Gravity
Green Triangle:
🔵
Adds Jump
Blue Square:
🟠
Adds Size
Orange Star:
Experiment with different flavour combinations to discover all 35 unique mixes, fill up the Slushie Journal and unlock the Total Brain Freeze Sticker!
Some combinations will affect you, while others will affect your pet.
Each effect lasts for at least 5 minutes, so there's plenty of time to enjoy your new abilities.
The Slushie Machine will be moving to the VIP area on November 20th, so make sure to try out all the combinations before then!
em
Psst.. if you have a Pinkypillar, try a mix of Red Spiral, Green Triangle and two pumps of Blue Square.
